summary.text: Log in to AIC’s eService portal with Singpass, then update your bank account details.

details.heading: Changing details for someone else
details.body: If you are changing the nominated bank account on behalf of a care recipient who lacks mental capacity, submit a Mental Incapacity Certification if you have not done so before.

steps.name: Log in
steps.text: Log in to AIC’s eService portal with your Singpass.

steps.name: Update details
steps.text: Update your bank account details for your CareShield Life or ElderShield claim payouts.

sources.page_title: How do I update my bank account details for my CareShield Life/ElderShield payouts?

quotes.text: You can log in to AIC’s eService portal (https://efinance.aic.sg) with your Singpass to update your bank account details for CareShield Life/ElderShield claim payouts.
If you are changing the nominated bank account on behalf of a care recipient who lacks mental capacity, you will need to submit a Mental Incapacity Certification if you have not done so before.
